verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own debugging agent (Seer), so asking whether it can connect to external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents registering or consuming MCP servers or their tools. The agent-tracing docs only cover monitoring other agents' tool calls, which is adjacent observability, not MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
